Country and location: Peru, Moquegua, 3 km (1.9 mi) southwest of La Capilla
Notes: Eighty-five adobe homes collapsed, and 558 others were damaged. Landslides occurred, blocking roads. Six people were injured and 85 people were left homeless.

Country and location: Ecuador, Guayas, 12 km (7.5 mi) southwest of Samborondón
Notes: At least 96 buildings were damaged, most of them in Guayaquil. In the town of Simón Bolívar, a 16-year-old boy died after being electrocuted by a falling power line. Two others were also injured.

El Salvador, Ahuachapán, 3 km (1.9 mi) west of Atiquizaya
Notes: It is a part of an earthquake swarm. One house collapsed and many others were damaged in Atiquizaya.

Country and location: Afghanistan, Paktika, 50 km (31 mi) southwest of Khost
Notes: Aftershock of the June 2022 Afghanistan earthquake. Six-hundred houses in the Gayan District were destroyed and 44 people were injured.

Country and location: Myanmar, Shan, 53 km (33 mi) south of Kengtung
Notes: In Kengtung, the wall of a school collapsed and some homes were damaged. Wall collapses were also reported in the villages of Naungfa and Katfa.

Country and location: Iran, Hormozgan, 69 km (43 mi) northeast of Bandar Lengeh
Notes: Aftershock of the doublet 6.0 earthquakes three weeks prior. Several houses were damaged and rockfalls blocked roads. One person was injured while fleeing in a panic.

Country and location: Ecuador, Carchi, 10 km (6.2 mi) north of San Gabriel
Notes: In Ecuador, at least 398 buildings were damaged, 41 of them severely. In neighboring Colombia, especially in the city of Túquerres, one house collapsed and 50 others were damaged. Nine people were injured, three of them suffering fractures and bruises.

Country and location: Turkey, Kahramanmaraş, 25 km (16 mi) south southeast of Kahramanmaraş
Notes: Some homes and a hospital collapsed in Kahramanmaraş.

Country and location: Ecuador, Carchi, 6 km (3.7 mi) south southwest of El Ángel
Notes: Aftershock of the 5.7 event the day prior. Additional damage was caused in Montúfar, where a previously weakened house collapsed.

Notes: Further information: 2022 Luzon earthquake

Country and location: Chile, Antofagasta, 52 km (32 mi) east northeast of Calama
Notes: Some minor damage was caused, such as objects falling off shelves. Rockslides were also reported.

Country and location: Chile, Antofagasta offshore, 22 km (14 mi) northwest of Tocopilla
Notes: A police station and a school were damaged in Tocopilla. One person was injured.

Country and location: India, Chhattisgarh, 16 km (9.9 mi) north northwest of Baikunthpur
Notes: Five labourers were injured near a mine in Baikunthpur.

Country and location: Indonesia, Bali offshore, 28 km (17 mi) west northwest of Bedugul
Notes: 40 homes in the Karangasem Regency suffered moderate damage.

Country and location: Iran, East Azerbaijan, 58 km (36 mi) north of Takab
Notes: Homes in two villages were damaged.

Country and location: Nepal, Sagarmatha, 27 km (17 mi) west of Bhojpur
Notes: Two schools and a police station were destroyed, and 475 other structures were damaged in the Khotang District.

Country and location: Iceland, Southern Peninsula, 1 km (0.62 mi) southeast of Vogar
Notes: It is the largest in a swarm of 10,000 quakes since 30 July, related to the volcanic eruption at Fagradalsfjall. In Kópavogur, part of a shopping center collapsed. Rockslides were also triggered.
